en.description:
Roll 20! is a dice roller made for Apple Watch. Raise your wrist, tap, and the dice tumble across the screen and land on your result. No phone, no table needed.

DICE FOR EVERY GAME
Roll a d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d20 or d100. Perfect for Dungeons & Dragons, Pathfinder and any other tabletop role-playing game, board games and quick decisions.

3D DICE
Real 3D dice that tumble and land on your result. Prefer the classic look? Switch to a big, clear number in Settings.

ROLL SEVERAL DICE AT ONCE
Roll up to 8 dice together, for example 3d6 for ability scores or 8d6 for a fireball. You see every die and the total.

ADVANTAGE AND DISADVANTAGE
Roll two d20 and keep the higher (advantage) or the lower (disadvantage) with one tap. The die that does not count fades out.

NATURAL 20 AND NATURAL 1
A natural 20 gets a golden flash and a celebratory tap on your wrist. A natural 1 gets a wobble and a sad tap. The effects can be switched off.

MODIFIERS
Turn the Digital Crown or tap + and − to add a modifier. Add it once to the total, or to every roll.

YOUR COLORS
Choose a color for each die and for its numbers from the presets, or mix your own custom color.

ROLL IN WAYS THAT FIT YOU
• Tap the die, shake your wrist, or use Double Tap (Apple Watch Series 9, Series 10, Ultra 2 and later).
• Ask Siri: "Roll a d20 in Roll 20!"
• Use the "Roll dice" action in Shortcuts, or assign it to the Action button on Apple Watch Ultra.
• Add the complication to your watch face and open a d20 straight from it.

MADE FOR THE WRIST
• Total of all your rolls, so you can keep track during a fight
• Rolling sounds and haptics, each can be switched off
• Always-On display support
• VoiceOver support and Reduce Motion
en.releaseNotes:
Roll 20! 3.0 is the biggest update yet.

• 3D dice: the dice now tumble and land on your wrist. Prefer the classic big number? Turn 3D dice off in Settings.
• Your colors: new default colors, plus a color mixer to make any color you like for each die and its numbers.
• Roll more dice: up to 8 dice at once (3d6, 5d8 and so on), with the total shown.
• Advantage and disadvantage: roll two d20 and keep the higher or the lower one.
• Natural 20 and natural 1: a golden flash and a special tap for a 20, a wobble and a different tap for a 1. Can be turned off in Settings.
• Modifiers made easy: turn the Digital Crown or tap + and − to add a bonus once to the total or to every roll. A Clear button resets it.
• Double Tap: pinch your fingers twice to roll (Apple Watch Series 9, Series 10, Ultra 2 and later).
• Siri, Shortcuts and the Action button: say "Roll a d20 in Roll 20!" or set up a roll in Shortcuts.
• New complication: the watch face complication now works with the latest watch faces. Your existing complication keeps working.
• Always-On display: calmer colors while your wrist is down.
• Settings are now a tap away at the bottom of the dice list.
• Better VoiceOver support: results are read out right after each roll.

Your settings and your colors are all still here. Happy rolling!

versionHistory.releaseNotes: Fixed an issue where the app complications would not display properly.

Added the ability to add negative modifiers. 
Plus small, under the hood improvements.
Updated complication images on smaller devices.

What's new: 

- Settings View 
Swipe right on the main screen to show it

- Sound and haptics
Hear and feel the rolls! 

- Shake to roll 
Simiply shake your wrist to roll the dice! Note this is off by default and needs to be enabled in the settings view. 

- WatchOS 8 and Apple Watch Ultra optimisations

This app has been updated by Apple to prepare for watchOS 27 compatibility. No new features are included.
